title: Winsheep
description: Resource pack for 1.21.5 and above that replace the face of every sheep with that of Minecraft YouTuber Winsweep
body: A fan project spawned from a misunderstanding on a Discord server where another member thought the name of Minecraft YouTuber Winsweep was actually Winsheep. It replaces the head texture of sheep with that of WinSweep's Minecraft skin.
